provenance.binary_audit: JNI bodies are offline call graph references only; no JNI/JVMTI entry or attachment helper is callable
abi_notes: JavaCalls takes const methodHandle&; no callee destruction
Thread allocation uses VM biased-locking alignment
Thread records NMT stack and destructor releases it
Failure cleanup destroys the JavaThread itself
TLAB initialization is conditional and accepts TLAB subobject
Universe thread-group and JavaThread object accessors are inline
Observation aliases are private Windows x64 functions or explicitly typed data/vtables; registration/JNI/JVMTI/WhiteBox bodies are offline provenance only and are never called.
VM_Operation has a virtual destructor at slot0, doit at slot1, 13 vtable entries and size40; genuine VM_Deoptimize supplies the remaining protocol.
Method set_not_compilable and set_not_osr_compilable use (this,int,bool,const char*); intrinsic_id/flags are uint16 at40/42. Dont-inline bit is4.

CompileBroker compiler activity is an int32 scalar: stop0/run1/shutdown2; UseCompiler is a bool scalar. CompilerThread::_task is audited from constructor stores and CompilerThread size is VMType-exported.
KlassHandle/instanceKlassHandle are trivial size8 metadata wrappers with _value0; Windows x64 by-value arguments contain raw metadata pointer bits.

Klass::_class_loader_data uses144; Java9 exports this inherited common-base field under InstanceKlass. Post class observer targets are define_instance_class/anonymous parse_stream/array completion/array CDS restoration.
ThreadClosure is size8 with do_thread at slot0; CompLevel_all=-2 for these AOT-enabled exact builds.
Interpreter codelets and cache fields come from offline exported VMStructs/VMTypes; no JVMTI event entry is invoked.
ThreadInVMfromJava size8 destructor15b910 includes reguard, VM-to-Java transition and async special-exit processing.

AbstractInterpreter::_entry_table normal index0/synchronized index1 are proven by the first two MethodKind source enumerators and distinct generate_all codelets. Unique normal/synchronized codelet names lead to generation with synchronized=false/true and exact RIP-relative load/store of table[0]/[1]. No JNI/JVMTI/WhiteBox code is called.

BasicType return selectors are the explicit integer enum assignments from the exact tagged globalDefinitions.hpp, whose source hash is recorded; _result_type is the independently audited one-byte BasicType cell.

Anonymous Klass predicate reads uint16 InstanceKlass::_misc_flags@274 and mask32, proved by exported VMStruct plus exact constructor ORcx0x20/storeword and tagged source. Hidden Klass is absent in these9/10 images.

ClassLoaderData::_deallocate_list and GrowableArray<Metadata*> size32/length0-width4/data24-width8 are independently proven by exact tagged declarations plus identified add_to_deallocate_list construction/append and free_deallocate_list reverse traversal. The latter filename and ShouldNotReachHere source-line argument identify the exact native body.

source_audits.subject: JavaFrameAnchor x86 saved RBP lifecycle
source_audits.layout_source: Matching publisher full PDB: JavaFrameAnchor size32, _saved_rbp_address offset24 storage_size8.
source_facts: javaFrameAnchor_x86.hpp declares _saved_rbp_address as a volatile intptr_t**; clear() clears it and copy() preserves it.
frame_x86.cpp sender_for_entry_frame() uses saved_rbp_address() to update the saved-link register map when the address is non-null.
macroAssembler_x86.cpp reset_last_Java_frame() clears saved_rbp_address together with the last Java SP, FP and PC.
